name: Bapalal Gomtighat Gotawala
signature_dish: Dakor na gota — the town's defining snack
why_it_matters: The single most-cited address for 'Dakor na gota' — running across 5 generations from the original Gomti Ghat outlet opposite the Ranchhodrai Temple, with a satellite outlet now in Ahmedabad. Gotas use a clove-cinnamon-pepper-fenugreek-coriander spice mix added to ground chickpea; magaj and lasan bhakarwadi are the lesser-known second-order recommendations.
insider_tip: Order gota fresh-fried to-go and eat by Gomti Lake — they stale within an hour. The Ahmedabad satellite is a different experience; only the Dakor original gives you the temple-side queue energy.
signature_address: Opposite Gomtighat Tower, Gomti Ghat, Dakor, Kheda District 388225

name: Shreeji Thal
area: GJ SH-12, near Dakor bus stand
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor's #1-ranked Dakor restaurant (4.0/5, ~12 reviews) — the de-facto thali sit-down on the Dakor-Vadodara highway near the bus stand. Unlimited dinner thali ~₹200; the staff aggressively refills and gives the temple yatri crowd a calm hall to sit between aarti slots.
insider_tip: Sits on the way from Dakor to Vadodara — useful as a planned lunch break if you're doing the temple as a same-day trip from Ahmedabad/Vadodara rather than staying overnight.
signature_address: Shreeji Thal Dining Hall, B-43, Gujarat State Highway 12, near Dakor bus stand, Dakor, Kheda District 388225

name: Maganlal Vallabhdas Gotawala (Gotawala & Company)
area: Holi Chakla, near Ranchhodrai Dakor Temple
why_it_matters: 100-year-old family business — the second pillar (alongside Bapalal Gomtighat) of Dakor's gota heritage, also known as Gotawala & Company. Manufactures the instant Dakor Gota Flour Mix that ships nationally via Amazon. Tripadvisor #3-ranked Dakor restaurant, 0.5 km from Ranchhodrai Temple.
insider_tip: Best as the takeaway-flour mix stop — buy 1-2 packets of the ready-to-cook flour to reproduce Dakor gota at home. The fresh-fried gotas here are slightly different from Bapalal's; try both to compare.
signature_address: Maganlal Vallabhdas Gotawala, Holi Chakla, Dakor, Kheda District 388225
